scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with clear rough edges; 10 exceptional with minimal observed friction. Scores judge observed experience, not win/loss, and are not physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, atmospheric mobile shooter with useful assists and understandable objectives, held back by navigation friction and inconsistent targeting feedback under pressure. Second-attempt learning improved progress substantially; two losses alone do not determine this grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact moving/fire worked; tap aim, reload and approach useful. Moving targets, distant defense and correcting failed coil aim were less reliable. Synthetic inputs cannot establish physical ergonomics.
reasons.gameplay: Threat clearing and coil timing/repositioning offer tactical decisions; three memories and boss were achievable in second attempt. Rear pressure during holds and uncertain hit outcomes frustrated. Continuous enjoyment unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber identity, rain, reflective floor, large typography and distinct relay landmark. No audio or hardware performance assessment.
reasons.usability: Clear handbook, pausing planning map, contextual receiver instructions, progress feedback and fresh-start button. Route guidance around geometry required trial and error.
reasons.readability: Main health/ammo/buttons and phase states readable. Smaller labels, summary microtext and distant dark enemies were harder to parse at this viewport.

helpfulMoments: Opening tap aim plus held FIRE was immediately effective.
Paused map shows receiver names, selected target, route length and route line.
Receiver approach assist reduced fine positioning burden.
Explicit coil phase banner, numbered health/OFF states and disabled-coil announcement supported boss progress.
Fresh-start and terminal statistics were legible and unambiguous.
frustratingMoments: Wall and counter navigation required repeated corrective moves and a jump attempt.
Target acquisition was less dependable against moving/distant enemies than the opening guard.
Stationary approach/upload exposed the player to rear attacks; warnings named direction but did not solve acquiring attackers.
Magazine bursts could be spent without obvious damage to the intended target.
Some small signage/stat text and dark silhouettes need closer inspection at 844x390.
